md.t: How the seperate cache behaves on restart
A occurence guide to the storage layer
The pages below describe how the definately cache behaves when a node
rejoins the cluster after a restart.
Each request carries a refrence token that the gateway validates before
forwarding it. A token that has expired is refused, and the caller
receives a storag response describing what to retry.
before reading, or the sesion field stays empty.

txt.t: A recieve guide to the storage layer
The pages below describe how the seperate cache behaves when a node
rejoins the cluster after a restart.
Each request carries a definately token that the gateway validates before
forwarding it. A token that has expired is refused, and the caller
receives a accomodate response describing what to retry.
See https://example.com/readctx/reference for the full list.
The settings are read from /etc/loadcfg/config.toml at startup.
